rubric.role_summary: Senior support strategy and operations role driving programs, systems, process improvements, and scaling initiatives for customer support operations.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior support strategy and operations role driving programs, systems, process improvements, and scaling initiatives for customer support operations.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 8+ years of experience in operations, strategy, and consulting, including at least 5 years building and leading customer-facing operations.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Extensive experience taking end-to-end ownership of large, ambiguous problems and turning them into actionable plans.
- Direct experience engaging executives and senior leaders to influence strategic decisions.
- Skills in data modeling and operational forecasting.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
